first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The man with a short crew cut leaning against the railing on the image-left, wearing a dark zip-up jacket and dark trousers.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The man leaning against the railing on the image-right, wearing a dark close-fitting knit cap, a dark leather jacket with wide, thick lapels, and a light-colored turtleneck top.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The man wearing a dark pom-pom hat, a light-colored hooded inner layer, and a thick coat with light-colored cuffs and hem trim, crossing the extreme foreground from left to right.

entities.name: multistory buildings along the street
entities.identification: The continuous multistory buildings on both sides of the road and the distant central spire, with rows of windows, pitched roofs, and rooftop signs.

entities.name: city road and intersection
entities.identification: The horizontal intersection below and the road extending toward the distant center and gradually converging.

entities.name: trees along the street
entities.identification: The groups of trees on both sides of the road, with irregular dark-gray crowns and dense branching twigs.

entities.name: overcast sky
entities.identification: The light-gray sky above and in the gaps between the buildings, with soft horizontal cloud patterns.

entities.name: cars on the road
entities.identification: Multiple cars of varying shades at the intersection and on the road receding into the distance, recorded as a background group of vehicles.

entities.name: long-bodied bus on the road
entities.identification: The group of background buses at the intersection below, with light-colored elongated bodies and rows of side windows.

entities.name: dark metal railing
entities.identification: The horizontal dark railing behind the people, with spaced vertical posts and visible widened bases.

entities.name: stone parapet
entities.identification: The parapet extending horizontally below the railing, with a wide dark upper section and a light-gray lower wall surface exposed farther back.

entities.name: pedestrians at the street intersection
entities.identification: The group of background pedestrians on both sides of the road and in the pedestrian areas at the intersection, excluding Person A, Person B, and Person D.

entities.name: streetlights along the street
entities.identification: The slender lamp posts on both sides of the road, with round or projecting lamp heads at the top.

entities.name: traffic light at the intersection
entities.identification: The vertical traffic-light assembly on a slender pole at the edge of the intersection.
